results.infractiontext: NO PERSON SHALL PLACE, LEAVE, ABANDON ANY DERELICT MOTOR VEHICLE ON ANY STREET
PARK AT A PLACE ON A STREET WHERE A TRAFFIC SIGN PROHIBITS PARKING
PARK ON A STREET WHERE A TRAFFIC SIGN RESTRICTS PARKING, EXCEPT IN ACCORDANCE WITH SUCH RESTRICTION
PARK ON ANY PORTION OF A STREET FOR A LONGER PERIOD OF TIME THAN INDICATED ON ANY TRAFFIC SIGN GOVERNING THAT PORTION OF A STREET
STOP AT A PLACE WHERE A TRAFFIC SIGN PROHIBITS STOPPING
STOP ON A LANE IN SUCH A MANNER AS TO LEAVE AVAILABLE LESS THAN 3M OF USABLE LANE FOR FREE MOVEMENT OF VEHICLES
STOP OR PARK OTHER THAN HEADED IN THE DIRECTION OF TRAFFIC
STOP WITHIN 2 METRES OF THE NEAREST EDGE OF THE CLOSEST SIDEWALK ON AN INTERSECTING STREET
WATER LAWN OR CULTIVATED BOULEVARD ADJ TO PREMISE - STAGE 3
WATER TREE, SHRUBS, FLOWERS OR PLANTS WITH A SPRINKLER OR SOAKER HOSE - STAGE 3
